in_marathi.name: Kunal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Black lotus, coal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kunal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kūñala’, meaning black lotus or coal. This name is associated with Lord Shiva and carries deep spiritual significance. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted as having a blue throat from consuming the poisonous Halahala. This color symbolizes the purity and strength of the god. The name Kunal embodies these powerful and transformative qualities.
